# In-the-wild study: agent pull requests that edit generated files (AIDev v5, AIDev-pop)

All numbers below were computed by the scripts in this folder on Tue Nov 10 2026 (EST). Nothing was posted or
published; GitHub was used read-only (REST `pulls/<n>` for the head SHA, raw.githubusercontent.com for content).

## Data
- Dataset: Hugging Face `hao-li/AIDev`, revision tag `v5` (AIDev-7.6M, cutoff 2026-03-31, CC BY 4.0), from
  Li, Zhang, Hassan, "The Rise of AI Teammates in Software Engineering (SE) 3.0" (arXiv:2507.15003) and
  "AIDev: Studying AI Coding Agents on GitHub" (arXiv:2602.09185). Downloaded to `build/data/aidev/`.
- Tables used: `pull_request.parquet` (AIDev-pop: repos with >100 stars; 361,296 PRs), `pr_commit_details.parquet`
  (12,116,310 commit x file rows with `filename`, `status`, `additions`, `deletions`, `patch`; 1,596,792 rows have a
  null patch because GitHub omits large patches).
- Agent labels are AIDev's (`Claude_Code`, `Copilot`, `Cursor`, `Devin`, `Google_Jules`, `OpenAI_Codex`).
- Unit of analysis: a PR = union of the files changed by its commits in `pr_commit_details`. Commits whose message
  starts with `Merge branch|Merge remote-tracking branch|Merge pull request|Merge commit|Merge '|Merge "` are
  excluded (they import base-branch changes the agent did not author).
- Denominator: **359,735 PRs** in AIDev-pop with at least one row in `pr_commit_details`.

## Definitions (exact rules in `gendetect.py`, unit-tested in `test_gendetect.py`)
- **Lockfile** (separate category, never "generated"): basename in a fixed list (package-lock.json, yarn.lock,
  pnpm-lock.yaml, bun.lock(b), poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, composer.lock, Gemfile.lock,
  flake.lock, Podfile.lock, pubspec.lock, ... 27 names).
- **(a) Path-detected generated file**: path matches one of 15 conventions: `_pb2(_grpc).py(i)`, `.pb.go`,
  `_grpc.pb.go`, `.pb.gw.go`, `.pb.cc/.h`, `_pb.js/.ts/.d.ts`, `_grpc_pb`, `_connect.ts`, `.pb*.dart`,
  `.pb/.grpc.swift`, `zz_generated*`, `[._]generated.<ext>`, `.gen.<ext>`, `_gen.go`, `.sql.go`,
  `.g/.freezed/.gr/.mocks/.config/.chopper/.reflectable.dart`, `.Designer.cs/.vb`, `.g(.i).cs`, or a directory
  component `generated`, `__generated__`, `_generated`, `autogen`, `auto_generated`, `auto-generated`.
- **(b) Header-detected generated file**: a *strong* marker in lines 1 to 15 of the file as visible in the patch
  (hunk line numbers are tracked; both old and new side): Go `Code generated .* DO NOT EDIT`, `@generated`,
  `<auto-generated`, or a word starting with `generat` together with a do-not-edit phrase (`do not edit|modify`,
  `changes will be lost`, `will be overwritten`, `manual changes`, ...). *Weak* markers (e.g. `Generated by Django`,
  `auto-generated` without a do-not-edit phrase) are recorded but NOT counted as generated.
- **Edited** generated file: status `modified` or `renamed` with additions + deletions > 0 (added/removed files are
  "touched" but not "edited").
- **Plausible source in the same PR** (deliberately generous, so "without source" is conservative): another
  non-removed, non-generated, non-lockfile file in the PR that is an IDL/spec/template (`.proto .thrift .avsc .fbs
  .graphql .prisma .sql .resx .xaml .j2 .tmpl .mustache .hbs .lark .g4 ...`), a spec-like YAML/JSON/TOML
  (path contains openapi|swagger|schema|asyncapi|spec), a generator config (`buf.gen.yaml`, `codegen.ts`,
  `sqlc.yaml`, `gqlgen.yml`, `openapitools.json`, `build.yaml`, `pubspec.yaml`, `Makefile`, `*.mk`, `justfile`,
  `Taskfile.yml`, `gen.go`, `generate.go`, `tools.go`, ...), a script whose path has a gen/generate/generator/
  codegen/regen/scaffold token, or a same-directory sibling with the generated stem (`foo.g.dart` <- `foo.dart`;
  `zz_generated.*` <- any `.go` in its directory; `X.Designer.cs` <- `X.cs/.resx/.settings/.xaml`).
  `package.json`, `go.mod`, `pyproject.toml` are NOT counted as sources (they change for dependency reasons).
- **Possibly disappearing PR** ("edit-gen w/o source"): edits >= 1 generated file (a or b) for which no plausible
  source changed in the same PR.

| Devin | 11,211 | 1,472 (13.1%) | 357 (3.2%) | 216 (1.9%) | 128 (59.3% of editing) | 88 (40.7%) | 69.5% (n=128) | 59.1% (n=88) | 58.6% (n=10,854) |
| Google_Jules | 3,456 | 356 (10.3%) | 39 (1.1%) | 32 (0.9%) | 7 (21.9% of editing) | 25 (78.1%) | 42.9% (n=7) | 40.0% (n=25) | 60.2% (n=3,417) |

| ALL | 359,735 | 34,416 (9.6%) | 7,147 (2.0%) | 4,965 (1.4%) | 1,983 (39.9% of editing) | 2,982 (60.1%) | 66.9% (n=1,983) | 66.8% (n=2,982) | 68.4% (n=352,588) |

Merge rate = merged / all PRs in the group (open PRs included). Merge rate among closed PRs only is in
`out/summary.json` (`merge_rate_closed`); ALL: 73.7% (w/o source), 74.0% (with source), 74.4% (no generated file).
Merge rates do not differ materially between groups; reviewers merge these PRs at the usual rate.

Touching (any status) a generated file and also touching its plausible source:
| Agent | touch gen: path (a) | touch gen: header (b) | all touched gen files have a source in PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claude_Code | 2,855 | 1,863 | 2,474 of 3,935 (62.9%) |
| Copilot | 1,058 | 1,110 | 999 of 1,894 (52.7%) |
| Cursor | 184 | 99 | 131 of 253 (51.8%) |
| Devin | 241 | 186 | 149 of 357 (41.7%) |
| Google_Jules | 34 | 19 | 28 of 39 (71.8%) |
| OpenAI_Codex | 456 | 316 | 321 of 669 (48.0%) |
| ALL | 4,828 | 3,593 | 4,102 of 7,147 (57.4%) |

PR-file pairs: 72,894 generated PR-file pairs (path only 34,163; header only 32,540; both 6,191); 37,318 edited,
of which 23,960 (64.2%) have a plausible source in the PR. Distinct repositories with an edited generated file:
1,075; with an edited generated file without source: 576.

## Header presence (who is invisible to header-based guards)
Seeded sample (seed 20261111, one pair per PR) of 200 path-detected generated files from the 4,828 PRs with one;
file fetched at the PR head commit (181 fetched; 19 unavailable: deleted repo/branch or file removed).
- Strong header in lines 1 to 15: 109/181 = 60.2% (95% Wilson CI 52.9 to 67.1%); weak only: 37 (20.4%);
  none: 35 (19.3%, CI 14.3 to 25.7%). So **39.8% of path-detected generated files carry no do-not-edit header in the
  first 15 lines**.
- With a 40-line window, 118/181 have a strong marker; 34.8% (CI 28.3 to 42.0%) still have none. The difference comes
  from Go files whose `Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT` line sits after a 15+ line license block (e.g. k8s
  `zz_generated.deepcopy.go`, some `.pb.go`).
- Re-implemented HeaderGuard rules (same regex and protobuf name rule as `genlineage/agent.py`, 15-line window):
  59/181 = **32.6% invisible** (CI 26.2 to 39.7%); with 40 lines, 28.7%. By rule, `generated_dir` (35 of 54 lack a
  strong header) and `.gen.*` (18 of 24, e.g. TanStack `routeTree.gen.ts`, hey-api `*.gen.ts`) dominate.
- Patch-vs-fetch agreement: every pair whose patch already showed a strong header (27 fetched) was strong at head;
  every pair whose patch covered lines 1 to 15 with no strong marker (11 fetched) had none (7) or weak (4).

## Hand audit of "possibly disappearing" edits (`sample_audit.csv`)
30 PR-file pairs sampled with `random.Random(20261110)` from the 1,983 "edit-gen w/o source" PRs (one pair per PR).
I read each patch and the PR's full file list (`out/audit_patches.txt`).
- Truly generated: 29/30 (one header false positive: a hand-written README that says *other* files are generated).
- consistent_regen 22/30: the generated file changed consistently with an ordinary hand-written input that the
  generous source rules cannot see (code-first generators: TanStack routes, Mockito mocks of a changed Dart service,
  hey-api/orval clients from changed backend models, MoonBit `.mbti` interfaces, roxygen NAMESPACE, ts-rs and
  tauri-specta bindings, Convex `_generated`). These edits would most likely survive regeneration.
- **hand_edit_lost 3/30 (10%, Wilson CI 3.5 to 25.6%)**: hand edits that regeneration would revert (an import moved
  above the orval banner; `window.*` rewritten to `globalThis` in `amy_api.generated.js`; rustfmt run over a
  `DO NOT EDIT` Lucide icons file after deleting its `#![rustfmt::skip]`).
- unclear 4/30 (two with no patch available; two where the generator itself may have changed).
Interpretation: the file-label signal "edits a generated file without its declared source" is a weak proxy. Most
such edits are legitimate outputs of code-first generators; a minority are true disappearing edits. Deciding which
requires knowing the generator's actual inputs, i.e. lineage, which is the point of LineageGuard component A.
A naive extrapolation (10% of 1,983) would be about 200 PRs; with the CI, roughly 70 to 510. This is an estimate
from n=30, not a measurement.

## Caveats
- AIDev-pop only (repos >100 stars); `pr_commit_details` may miss commits beyond the first 30 of very large PRs
  (AIDev v5 note) and omits large patches (null patch: header status unknown, not "absent").
- Per-commit union, not the PR's net diff: a file changed and reverted inside a PR still counts as touched.
- Path rules miss generators without naming conventions (e.g. hey-api output written as `types.ts`), and the
  `generated_dir` and `.gen.` rules include some non-code artifacts (JSON data, docs). Header markers in the patch
  are a lower bound (only visible when a hunk covers the top of the file).
- "Source in PR" is generous on purpose but cannot see code-first inputs (see audit); "without source" is
  therefore an upper bound on true disappearing edits, and the audit is the calibration.
- Merge rate is not a quality label; a merged disappearing edit can still be lost at the next regeneration.

## Reproduce (exact commands, run from the repository root)
```
python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install pyarrow==26.0.1 pandas==3.1.1 huggingface_hub==2.4.0
venv/bin/python -I -c "from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download as h; [h('hao-li/AIDev', t+'.parquet', repo_type='dataset', revision='v5', local_dir='data/aidev') for t in ['pull_request','repository','pr_commits','pr_commit_details']]"
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/test_gendetect.py
(ulimit -v 5000000; venv/bin/python -I inthewild/mine.py data/aidev inthewild/out)       # 336 s pass 1 + 20 s pass 2, <1 GB RAM
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/analyze.py data/aidev inthewild/out                        # summary.json, pairs.csv.gz, samples
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/fetch_headers.py inthewild/out/header_sample.csv inthewild/out/header_fetch.csv   # ~200 REST calls
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/dump_audit.py inthewild/out > inthewild/out/audit_patches.txt
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/make_audit_csv.py                                          # judgments are hard-coded there
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/header_stats.py inthewild/out/                             # header_summary.json
venv/bin/python -I inthewild/tables.py inthewild/out/                                   # tables above
```
Note: streaming `pr_commit_details` with default pyarrow settings used 9 GB RSS and triggered the kernel OOM
killer (it also killed the shared ollama runner); `mine.py` uses `pre_buffer=False`, 4,000-row batches.

## Re-check against net PR diffs (added Nov 10 2026, ~6:05 AM EST, main pipeline)
Spot re-check via the GitHub REST API: tulipcc#749 confirmed (generated file in the net PR diff). PostHog#48983, judged
hand_edit_lost above, is NOT in the net PR diff: the edit came from a "chore: update OpenAPI generated types" commit,
i.e. a regeneration. The paper therefore reports 3/30 as audited (Wilson 95% CI 3.5 to 25.6%) and 2/30 confirmed
(CI 1.8 to 21.3%). Raw AIDev data (13 GB, CC BY 4.0) and fetched third-party file contents are not redistributed;
`mine.py` and `fetch_headers.py` rebuild them.
